population.snapshot: benchmarks/evaluation/real-project-v2/population.json, produced by the first complete source-only capture after this protocol is committed; it records the UTC capture timestamp, exact GitHub API requests, returned repository metadata, and observed default-branch commits
population.eligibility: Public, non-fork, non-mirror, non-archived GitHub repositories in the profile's recorded GitHub language with an exact default-branch commit, a GitHub-reported SPDX license, at least minimumStars stars at capture time, at least minimumSourceFiles eligible source files, a recorded root build marker, and a reported repository size no greater than maximumRepositorySizeBytes.
population.exclusions: Exclude paths under vendored, dependency, generated, derived-output, test-only, example, and benchmark directories; exclude each profile's recorded file suffixes; exclude truncated GitHub trees; and exclude every repository selected by a hash-linked prior evaluation slice. Source-only eligibility, rank, exclusion, and replacement decisions must not consult Bifrost or language-server outcomes.

sampling.seedDerivation: For each language/candidate profile, rank every eligible repository by the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of `usagebench-` + freezeId + `\0` + the Git commit that introduced this protocol + `\0` + language + `\0` + candidate ID + `\0` + repository full name. Sort bytewise ascending and use source metadata only. A later declaration draw must use the same domain with `declaration\0` and the portable URI plus zero-based range appended.
sampling.replacementRule: Persist the complete ranked population, including exclusions and reasons, before drawing. Select the first four eligible repositories and require at least four additional eligible repositories as replacement headroom. A source-only eligibility failure replaces a repository with the next unused eligible rank. Declaration authoring may later replace a declaration only with the next recorded source-only candidate from the same pinned repository, or replace the repository by the same rank order if that list is exhausted. Record each replacement before any analyzer run.

claimScope: This independent slice supports only descriptive per-profile comparisons for the source-only sampled Java, Rust, and C++ repositories and the References and Definition operations recorded here. Report v2 separately. A combined v1/v2 view may preserve and aggregate only documented language/profile strata and their denominators; it must not pool the slices into language-wide, ecosystem-wide, cross-language, latency, memory, or cold-start claims.
